# FOWL AI

> FOWL AI is a weekly newsletter and career-intelligence site that helps knowledge workers navigate and profit from the AI economy — AI jobs, vetted AI training/evaluation platforms, and plain-English explainers on AI tools and terminology.

FOWL AI publishes a new issue every Monday covering AI jobs, training platforms, startup opportunities, and career signals for the AI economy. Content is first-hand and numbers-driven (real pay, real contracts, real screenshots) rather than theoretical. All issues stay public and are free to read without a subscription.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.fowl-ai.com/): Overview of FOWL AI and the latest issue.
- [All Issues](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/): Full archive of every weekly issue, newest first.
- [AI Jobs Board](https://www.fowl-ai.com/jobs/): Curated AI evaluation gigs and emerging career opportunities, updated weekly.
- [AI Platforms Directory](https://www.fowl-ai.com/platforms/): Vetted AI training and evaluation platforms, ranked by accessibility.
- [AI Glossary](https://www.fowl-ai.com/glossary/): Plain-English definitions of LLM, Agent, MCP, Skills, and Claude CLI, each with a real-world example.
- [AI & Future of Work FAQ](https://www.fowl-ai.com/faq/): Straight answers on job risk, real pay, required skills, and whether AI training/evaluation gigs are 1099 or W2 employment in the United States.
- [FOWL AI Tests](https://www.fowl-ai.com/tests/): Monthly head-to-head AI tool comparisons using real downloaded output files, not just chat transcripts. No sponsorships.
- [Products & Guides](https://www.fowl-ai.com/products/): Guides and templates for building AI-era income.
- [About](https://www.fowl-ai.com/about/): Who writes FOWL AI and why it exists.
- [LaunchLab: Brand Brain](https://www.fowl-ai.com/launchlab/): A guided AI workspace ("AI Building Partner") that teaches you how to turn an idea into a website, newsletter, AI avatar, and digital products you own. $99 Founding Edition. A separate business powered by FOWL AI. See also: [Own Your AI Brand](https://www.fowl-ai.com/launchlab/own-your-ai-brand/) (Playbook $39 / Builder Pack $99).

## Latest Issues

- [Issue 18: California is about to make it illegal for an algorithm to fire you alone.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-09-21/): California’s No Robo Bosses Act would ban firing or disciplining workers solely by automated system, with a named human reviewer, written notice, and a right to your own data. Newsom decides by September 30. Plus: Connecticut and Illinois already moved, 6 in 10 managers already use AI on personnel calls, and the emotion-surveillance ban on the same desk.
- [Issue 17: AI didn't shrink the job market — it rerouted it into hard hats.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-09-14/): The Economist says AI created about a million U.S. jobs since 2023 — almost all in construction and skilled trades, not tech. Plus: the AI-layoff verification gap, WRITER's disappointment survey, PwC's 8x skills-growth data, and the C-suite's new two-tier workforce.
- [Issue 16: Microsoft built a 6,000-person army to install AI inside your company.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-09-07/): Microsoft's $2.5 billion Frontier Company, AWS's $1 billion answer, and matching bets from Accenture and Salesforce all point at one job — forward deployed engineer — up roughly 42x in two years and paying $215K to $1.2M+ depending on level.
- [Issue 15: The AI trainer gig economy just split into two tiers.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-08-31/): Mercor's annualized revenue passed $2 billion and Surge AI is reportedly in talks near a $25 billion valuation, while generalist AI-rating queues are going empty and rates are sliding batch to batch. The gap between the two tiers is now roughly 10x — plus the new "Reward Model Evaluator" title and where each tier is actually hiring.
- [Issue 14: AI skills now pay a 62% wage premium. Here's what it's actually pricing.](https://www.fowl-ai.com/issues/2026-08-24/): PwC's 2026 Global AI Jobs Barometer puts the AI skills wage premium at 62%, up from 57% last year. Upwork's freelance data and Writer's enterprise survey show the same split underneath the number: it follows workflow ownership, not tool fluency — plus the emerging "AI Orchestrator" title and the domain-expert eval tier paying 6-10x the generalist rate.
